equations: dn_in=actual_standard_volume_flow*101325/(R*273.15)*dt; source reservoirs finite and inlet pressure decreases; MFC first-order tau explicitly assumed
Motor starts and holds 10s before solenoid opens; manual flapper modulates effective S<=0.004m3/s; gas removal exponential toward standalone pump base0.3Pa; auto motor hysteresis may cycle
Total initial_U+electrical+Hin-Hout-environment-collected=stored_U; solve temperature after each finite species/energy transfer; no double-counted reaction enthalpy
NASA7 Cp/R=a0+a1*T+a2*T²+a3*T³+a4*T⁴; integrate h and s per source, each record range checked
3kW PI heater; program nominal0–20K/min plus installed-tube piecewise slew caps5/10/5K/min and explicitly assumed high-band cap; P stores4 curves total40 segments
Flipping clamshell cuts heater only; sealed tube remains sealed. Flange opening/unloading requires cold and atmospheric pressure; fan stop threshold uses separate body temperature333.15K
Host.step sole clock, integration<=0.05s; zero duration no change; no per-asset hidden wall-clock or environment cross-talk

maximum vacuum -0.1MP3单位错误，不能作0Pa绝对压；系统10–100Pa与单独泵极限0.3Pa分列。
装管升温500℃以下≤5℃/min、500–800≤10、800–1000≤5；1000–1200段≤2t℃/min字符有误。额定0–20保留；高段限速必须显式假设，示例2℃/min不标documented。
空炉≤15min升温描述不能推作满载室温到1200℃保证，尤其与装管分段限速并存。
冻结P单温区：3kW、均温区210mm、4条曲线合计40段、双行LED五键；不混入T的7英寸触屏50段/USB和双温区280mm/3.2kW。
温度±1℃/显示1℃为厂家指标；模拟量化误差测试不是实机准确度或温场均匀性验证。风机60℃条件按炉体温度，不等同炉膛温度。
全部SI；地面支承投影中心为Z0（落地组合机组），炉体支承平面Z0.778m；总质量210kg不分配为实测部件质量，URDF0.1kg/件仅数值代理。【B1】URDF分件仿真质量改为按构件工程拆分（余量计入顶板/底座），仍非实测。

机柜并排、圆角/波纹管/把手位置由照片估计；炉体包络980×400×600mm、石英管OD50/ID43/L1000mm，加热420mm且单区均温210mm单列。【B1】单柜770×580×778 mm按System Dimensions解读；两柜间20 mm缝、柜门/面板布局、脚轮位置按照片估计。【B1 r1】炉膛按厂家“Furnace size Inner φ120×420 mm”建成上下半圆腔；开盖范围按厂家“Clamshell back flip (about 100 degrees)”；管件列按照片伸到机柜侧面，软管按照片外绕。
准均匀理想气体，Tgas=Tamb+heated_fraction*(Toven-Tamb)；未模拟轴向温场/CFD/真实密封、反向分子流/泵曲线。
反应仅CH4→C(gr)+2H2的有限守恒教学模型；速率系数/活化能/捕获率/膜密度均显式synthetic。气相NASA表不启用325条燃烧反应，不自动生成氧化物CVD。
MFC量程、N2等效校正、标准体积273.15K101325Pa、1阶响应/流路阻力均显式输入或假设。厂家±1%FS/≤4s响应只作规格，不等于已标定。
气源为宿主提供有限等温储气容积，随存量降压；不宣称真实减压阀控制。宿主负责瓶/基底附着、泄漏检查、尾气处理，robot/hardware absent。
示例允许t0显式热态预装快照，初始化热量入账，不能在运行中注入温度/样品。正常冷机升温不瞬移；完成工艺不等于可热卸样。
公开参考库54条＝53种气相状态（CH2电子态分列）+1固态石墨，非54种瓶装气体/可沉积材料；4条真实石墨烯生长表观活化焓仅离线参考，50种本机沉积规律仍缺口。
能量账本边界为炉膛、样品、炉体和气体/沉积物；不包括机械泵550W、风机或MFC电耗。t0指首次plant.configure初始化时刻，不要求全局宿主时钟为零。
自动真空为有10秒重启延时的电机滞环模型，可能超出目标压带；惰性气持续补给，前驱体和保温计时仅在模型温压有效时推进，不把设定压力当实际压力。
上翻炉盖只切加热不破坏两端已密封石英管真空；卸法兰/基底需冷却且回常压。急停不能撤销已发生沉积/耗气。
54 thermochemical reference states are not54 compatible CVD precursors or50 measured deposition curves.
Only CH4 carbon deposition instantiated; Cu(111) graphene apparent activation enthalpies retained separately and not used to calibrate rate_ref/Ea.
Single lumped zone and body node; no spatial temperature/CFD/nucleation/roughness/growth chemistry/film characterization.
Effective pumping, MFC tau/full scales/correction factors, thermal constants and kinetics all explicit host assumptions; no calibrated controller or 1%FS hardware validation.
No O2/H2/CH4 combustion, toxic/pyrophoric handling, certified safety or real piping/leak/overtemperature trip hardware.
Full P five-key menu, firmware EEPROM, physical quartz seals, host grasp/contact and real hardware absent; T touchscreen/USB intentionally absent.
